en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning as northern downpours continue
en.dek: The amber signal went up at 5:40pm, with the northern New Territories flooding announcement and the afternoon thunderstorm warning still in force.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 新界北部大雨持續
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告於下午5時40分生效，新界北部水浸特別報告及下午的雷暴警告仍然有效。

en.headline: August retail sales rise 5.6% to HK$32.1 billion
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said the gain was the 16th straight monthly increase, with online sales up 9.9%.

zh.headline: 八月零售銷貨價值升5.6% 至321億元
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布臨時數字，按年升幅為連續第16個月擴張，網上銷售升9.9%。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 640 points, back under 24,000
en.dek: The index finished at 23,972 after a holiday-delayed session, with AIA, Standard Chartered and HSBC leading the fall.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌640點 失守二萬四
zh.dek: 假期後首個交易日恒指收報23972點，友邦、渣打及滙控領跌，全日成交1458億元。

en.headline: Clara Chan reappointed Hong Kong Investment Corporation chief for three years
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the board had renewed her term from 9 October, citing patient capital and reasonable returns.

zh.headline: 陳家齊再任港投公司行政總裁 任期三年
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波宣布董事會再度委任陳家齊，新任期於10月9日生效，並指投資取得合理回報。

en.headline: Rescuers search Kowloon Peak after climber falls
en.dek: Police were told shortly after 2:30pm that a man had fallen while climbing with a colleague near Suicide Cliff. Fire crews and a helicopter were sent.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山攀石男墮下 消防及飛行服務隊搜救
zh.dek: 警方下午約2時半接報，一名男子與同事在自殺崖一帶攀石時墮下，救援人員正登山施救。

en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games squash team silver
en.dek: The side lost the Nagoya final 1-2 to Malaysia after Chan Sin-yuk levelled the tie.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球女團決賽負馬來西亞 港隊摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊在名古屋決賽以場數1比2落敗，陳善鈺先扳平場數，李嘉兒第三場直落落敗。

en.headline: Helper minimum wage set at HK$5,220 for new contracts
en.dek: The government guide says the rate applies to contracts signed from 3 October. The food allowance stays at HK$1,236.

zh.headline: 外傭規定最低工資調至5220元 明日起新約適用
zh.dek: 政府指引列明，每月5220元適用於10月3日或以後簽訂的合約，膳食津貼維持不少於1236元。

en.headline: Observatory warns of flooding risk around Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 5pm announcement said more than 70 millimetres of rain fell in an hour in the northern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發新界北部水浸特別報告 上水雨勢較大
zh.dek: 下午5時的特別報告指新界北過去一小時錄得超過70毫米雨量，上水一帶尤其明顯。

en.headline: Observatory extends afternoon thunderstorm warning to 6:30pm
en.dek: A warning issued at 3:55pm was kept in force until 6:30pm, with isolated storms expected over Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 天文台下午雷暴警告延長至6時30分
zh.dek: 下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告延長至下午6時30分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: 90.4% of Wang Fuk Court owners have signed sale agreements
en.dek: Housing secretary Winnie Ho said the figure was as of 30 September, with signing due by 15 October.

zh.headline: 截至9月30日 宏福苑90.4%業主已簽買賣協議
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，業主須於10月15日或之前完成簽署，解說專隊會繼續支援揀樓。

en.headline: Hong Kong takes two sailing golds in youth 29er events
en.dek: The men's and women's youth 29er crews both won in Nagoya, a day that also included an ILCA 7 silver.

zh.headline: 亞運帆船青年29人級港隊再奪兩金
zh.dek: 男女子青年快速艇29人級均稱冠，連同ILCA 7銀牌，帆船隊單日兩金一銀。

en.headline: Golden Week day one sees 1.08 million border crossings
en.dek: Immigration figures for Thursday show more than 590,000 arrivals, including about 277,000 mainland visitors.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日進出境約108萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處周五公布周四全日數字，入境逾59萬人次，當中內地旅客約27萬7千。

en.headline: Hung Shing Temple and Stanley Mosque declared monuments
en.dek: The Development Bureau gazetted the Wan Chai temple and the mosque inside Stanley Prison as statutory monuments on Friday.

zh.headline: 灣仔洪聖古廟及赤柱清真寺列法定古蹟
zh.dek: 發展局周五刊憲，古物事務監督根據《古物及古蹟條例》宣布兩座建築列為法定古蹟。

en.headline: Customs seize cigarettes worth HK$1.88 million at Man Kam To
en.dek: Officers found about 360,000 suspected illicit cigarettes mixed with vegetables on an inbound truck and arrested the driver.

zh.headline: 海關文錦渡檢約36萬支懷疑私煙
zh.dek: 入境運菜貨車的63個發泡膠箱混有懷疑私煙，市值約188萬元，司機被捕保釋。

en.headline: Observatory extends thunderstorm warning until 2:30pm
en.dek: The warning first issued at 11:50am was kept in force for another hour, covering isolated storms over the northern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台延長雷暴警告至下午2時30分
zh.dek: 上午11時50分發出的雷暴警告再延長一小時，預料新界北有局部雷暴。

en.headline: Showers linger this weekend before a cooler Monday
en.dek: The Observatory expects cloudy spells and showers on Saturday and Sunday, then a fresher northeast monsoon from Sunday night.

zh.headline: 周末仍有驟雨 周一早上稍涼
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六日大致多雲有驟雨，周日晚東北季候風補充，隨後轉涼及雨勢減弱。

en.headline: Pui takes Asian Games silver in men's ILCA 7 sailing
en.dek: Pui Chun-lung finished second in the men's ILCA 7, two points behind the Korean winner, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 貝俊龍亞運男子ILCA 7帆船摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊貝俊龍在名古屋亞運男子單人艇ILCA 7以11分位列第二，落後韓國選手兩分奪銀。

en.headline: Ho Man Tin luxury site draws at least 10 bids at noon close
en.dek: The Fat Kwong Street residential site closed at noon with at least 10 tenders, including bids from major developers, reports said.

zh.headline: 何文田佛光街住宅地中午截標 最少10份標書
zh.dek: 何文田佛光街私人住宅用地中午截標，現場最少收到10份標書，多間大型發展商入標。

en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning valid until 1:30pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory warned of isolated thunderstorms until 1:30pm, with heavier showers expected in some districts over the next hour or two.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至下午1時30分
zh.dek: 天文台警告本港有局部雷暴，有效至下午1時30分，並指未來一兩小時部分地區雨勢可能較大。

en.headline: Wong reaches Asian Games men's singles tennis final
en.dek: Coleman Wong beat Uzbekistan's Sultanov to reach the final and is assured of at least silver, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 黃澤林闖亞運網球男單決賽 最少奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊黃澤林擊敗烏茲別克球手蘇丹諾夫晉身決賽，香港電台指他坐銀望金。

en.headline: Hang Seng down 2.6% by late morning after holiday break
en.dek: The benchmark stood at 23,975.90 at 11:05am, down 637 points from Wednesday's close, after opening 513 points lower.

zh.headline: 國慶假期後復市 恒指上午跌逾六百點
zh.dek: 恒指上午11時05分報23975點，較周三收市跌637點；今早低開513點，盤中曾低見23865點。

en.headline: HKEX chief says investors want more than equities
en.dek: Bonnie Chan told RTHK that Hong Kong should build a broader asset ecosystem, citing stronger turnover and renewed interest in gold futures.

zh.headline: 陳翊庭：港股以外也要建多元資產生態圈
zh.dek: 港交所行政總裁在港台節目表示，投資者希望配置股票以外的資產，並提到成交回升及美元黃金期貨反應。

en.headline: M+ stays open until 10pm today for Golden Week
en.dek: West Kowloon says M+ and the Palace Museum will keep extended hours through 7 October, and asks visitors to book ahead.

zh.headline: 黃金周西九兩館延長開放 M+今晚十時閉館
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，M+及故宮文化博物館在國慶黃金周維持延長開放，並建議訪客預先購票。

en.headline: Fixed-rate mortgages take 37.4% of new loans, an eight-year high
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's August survey shows fixed-rate plans rising for a 12th month, while newly approved mortgage lending fell to HK$32.2 billion.

zh.headline: 八月定息按揭佔新批貸款37.4% 創逾八年高
zh.dek: 金管局調查顯示，定息按揭佔比連升十二個月；新批住宅按揭貸款額跌至322億元。

en.headline: Tai Kwun film exhibition closes on Sunday
en.dek: Better Together, on Hong Kong cinema's team spirit, runs at Tai Kwun's Duplex Studio until 4 October, with tickets at HK$30.

zh.headline: 大館香港電影展覽周日結束
zh.dek: 「拍住上」展覽在中環荷李活道十號大館一號館複式展室展至十月四日，普通票三十元。

en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Telford Plaza restaurant after rodent complaint
en.dek: Inspectors found poor hygiene at the Kowloon Bay restaurant and issued a rodent notice, as a two-week food-premises sweep begins.

zh.headline: 食環署巡查德福廣場食肆後提出檢控
zh.dek: 署方指九龍灣該食肆衛生欠佳，已發消除蟲鼠通知，並展開為期兩星期的天羅行動。

en.headline: Three substances to be listed under Dangerous Drugs Ordinance
en.dek: The Security Bureau said the amending order would be gazetted on Friday, tabled in LegCo on 7 October and take effect on 27 November.

zh.headline: 三款物質納入危險藥物條例 周五刊憲
zh.dek: 保安局表示修訂令周五刊登憲報，十月七日提交立法會先訂立後審議，預計十一月二十七日生效。

en.headline: Neon archive show at Blue Lotus closes on Sunday
en.dek: Keith Macgregor's City of Lights runs at the Sheung Wan gallery through 4 October, documenting Hong Kong neon from the 1990s and 2000s.

zh.headline: 上環藍蓮畫廊霓虹攝影展周日結束
zh.dek: 攝影師Keith Macgregor的City of Lights在太平山街磅巷展至十月四日，記錄九十及二千年代香港霓虹。

en.headline: Observatory issues morning thunderstorm warning for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6:10am, valid until 8:30am, for isolated storms over the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台早上發出雷暴警告 新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時10分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午8時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Chu takes omnium silver as sailors medal in Nagoya
en.dek: Chu Tsun-wai scored 166 points for men's omnium silver, while Hong Kong also took silver and bronze in the skiff events on Thursday.

zh.headline: 朱浚瑋全能賽摘銀 帆船再添一銀一銅
zh.dek: 朱浚瑋在名古屋亞運男子全能賽以166分奪銀；女子49erFX得銀，男子49er得銅。

en.headline: Man dies after rescue off Hung Hom promenade
en.dek: Firefighters pulled an unconscious man from the water off Kin Wan Street on Thursday night; he was later confirmed dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 紅磡海濱男子墮海 送院後不治
zh.dek: 周四晚上約九時二十一分，建灣街海濱長廊對開有男子墮海，消防救起時已昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院後證實不治。

en.headline: Victoria Park lantern show stays lit through Golden Week
en.dek: The Tourism Board's International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park runs until 7 October, with free entry and lights from 6:30pm to 11pm.

zh.headline: 維園國際彩燈展延至十月七日 黃金周繼續亮燈
zh.dek: 旅發局的國際彩燈匯在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園展出至十月七日，免費入場，每晚六時半至十一時亮燈。

en.headline: More than half of Po Pin Chau bookings unused on National Day
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,160 people arrived on Thursday against roughly 2,420 bookings, and released slots on the day.

zh.headline: 國慶日破邊洲逾半預約未到 漁護署即場放額
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，周四約有2420人預約破邊洲段，實際到訪約1160人，包括即場放額後補上的遊人。

en.headline: Nearly 270,000 mainland visitors entered by 9pm on day one
en.dek: Immigration officers recorded more than 897,000 cross-boundary movements by 9pm on Thursday, with most mainland arrivals using Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日晚上九時近27萬內地旅客入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，截至星期四晚上九時，各管制站錄得逾89.7萬人次出入境，內地旅客入境近27萬，以落馬洲支線最多。

en.headline: Italian gelato market runs at PMQ through the holiday weekend
en.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest is at PMQ in Central from 1 to 4 October, with a second weekend listed for 9 to 11 October and free entry.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集假期在中環元創方舉行
zh.dek: 「Ciao! Gelato Fest」十月一日至四日在中環元創方舉行，主辦方另列十月九日至十一日為第二個週末，入場免費。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning lapses after overnight extension
en.dek: The Observatory's thunderstorm warning, extended until 1am, is no longer in force, while the very hot weather and yellow fire danger warnings remain.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至凌晨一時後不再生效
zh.dek: 天文台昨晚把雷暴警告延長至凌晨一時，現時已不再列為生效；酷熱天氣警告及黃色火災危險警告仍然有效。

en.headline: Police say about 380,000 watched National Day fireworks
en.dek: Officers put the Victoria Harbour crowd at about 380,000 after the 23-minute display, above the earlier estimate of 260,000.

zh.headline: 警方稱約38萬人觀賞國慶煙花匯演
zh.dek: 煙花匯演結束後，警方表示約有38萬人在維港兩岸觀賞，高於事前預估26萬人。

en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning for eastern New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised a thunderstorm warning at 9:30pm, valid until 11:30pm, for isolated storms in the eastern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界東部有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台晚上9時30分發出雷暴警告，有效至晚上11時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Observatory expects showers as monsoon nears after hot day
en.dek: The 6.30pm bulletin said temperatures topped 34 degrees in many places, with showers and thunderstorms overnight and a high of about 31 on Friday.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚有驟雨 東北季候風明日起影響
zh.dek: 晚上6時30分報告指多處下午高見34度，今晚及明日有驟雨及雷暴，明日氣溫約27至31度。

en.headline: National Day fireworks display held over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: The 23-minute show began at 8pm with 31,888 shells, as police had expected about 260,000 people on both sides of the harbour.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演維港上演 歷時約23分鐘
zh.dek: 煙花晚上8時開始，發放31,888枚煙花；警方預計約26萬人在兩岸觀賞。

en.headline: Customs probe Hotstone Yoga closure as complaints hit 27
en.dek: The Consumer Council said it had taken 27 complaints worth HK$429,326 by 5pm, while Customs posted an investigation notice at the Jordan studio.

zh.headline: 海關調查Hotstone Yoga結業 消委會接27宗投訴
zh.dek: 消委會表示截至下午5時接27宗投訴，涉款429,326元；海關在佐敦分店外張貼調查告示。

en.headline: Police arrest two over alleged sedition near Prince Edward
en.dek: Authorities said a 37-year-old man and a 58-year-old woman were detained on Wednesday in a case linked to an August gathering outside the MTR station.

zh.headline: 警方拘兩人 指涉太子站外煽動意圖
zh.dek: 警方稱周三拘捕37歲男子及58歲女子，案件與8月31日太子站外聚集有關；兩人尚未被控。

en.headline: Harbour roads shut and MTR exits closed ahead of fireworks
en.dek: Police staged closures on both sides of Victoria Harbour were in force by early evening, and the MTR shut selected Tsim Sha Tsui and West Kowloon exits.

zh.headline: 煙花前維港兩岸封路 港鐵關閉部分出口
zh.dek: 國慶煙花晚上8時開始，警方分階段封路已生效；港鐵關閉尖沙咀、尖東及西九龍站部分出口。

en.headline: 225,000 mainland visitors in by 4pm on Golden Week day one
en.dek: Immigration figures reported for Thursday afternoon put total crossings at about 601,000, with mainland arrivals already above Wednesday's full-day count.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日下午4時 逾22.5萬內地旅客入境
zh.dek: 入境處數字顯示，截至周四下午4時全市出入境約60.1萬人次，內地旅客入境已多過周三全日。

en.headline: Hotstone Yoga shuts all studios after sudden notice
en.dek: The hot-stone yoga chain told customers it would stop classes after Wednesday's hours, citing business circumstances, as members said packages were still being sold days earlier.

zh.headline: Hotstone Yoga全線結業 學員稱結業前仍售套票
zh.dek: 岩盤瑜伽連鎖店周三發出通告，指因業務情況於當日營業時間後停止課程；有學員稱數日前仍被推銷續會。

en.headline: Hong Kong adds cycling silver and squash bronze in Nagoya
en.dek: Lee Sze-wing and Leung Wing-yee took Madison silver by a point, the men's squash team settled for bronze, and Wong Chak-lam reached the tennis semi-finals.

zh.headline: 亞運麥迪遜港隊摘銀 壁球男團得銅
zh.dek: 李思穎與梁穎儀以31分、一分之差奪女子麥迪遜銀牌；男團壁球四強不敵巴基斯坦得銅，黃澤林則鎖定網球獎牌。

en.headline: Man dies after rescue at Peng Chau open-water race
en.dek: Police said a 58-year-old foreign competitor was found unconscious off Tung Wan around noon and died after a helicopter transfer to Eastern Hospital.

zh.headline: 坪洲泳賽外籍男疑遇溺 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方稱中午約12時21分接報，58歲外籍參賽者在東灣對開昏迷，經直升機送東區醫院後證實不治。

en.headline: Marine Department tightens harbour rules for 8pm fireworks
en.dek: A sea exclusion zone off the Convention Centre runs from 2pm to about 10pm, with a central harbour restriction from 7pm as the National Day display is fired from barges.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花今晚8時 海事處設禁區並提醒海上安全
zh.dek: 會展對開海面今日下午2時至約10時設禁區，維港中部晚上7時起實施限制區；觀賞船須備乘客名單，兒童須穿救生衣。

en.headline: Australian man arrested over imitation firearm in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police said a 36-year-old man was seized at a Temple Street bar on Wednesday night after reports of a gun-like object, and later arrested again for alleged criminal damage in custody.

zh.headline: 油麻地酒吧檢仿製手槍 36歲澳洲籍男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方指周三晚接報廟街酒吧有人攜類似手槍物品，當場拘捕男子並檢獲懷疑仿製曲尺氣槍；扣留期間再涉刑事毀壞。

en.headline: New World to hand 11 SKIES back to Airport Authority
en.dek: The developer will surrender three office towers and an entertainment hub from 1 April 2027 and pay more than HK$3 billion, after an HK$18.3 billion writedown on the airport project.

zh.headline: 新世界交還11 SKIES予機管局 另付逾30億
zh.dek: 集團將於2027年4月1日起交還三幢辦公樓及娛樂樞紐，並支付逾30億港元；年結就項目減值約183億元。

en.headline: Ho Man Tin and Mong Kok power restored after overnight outage
en.dek: CLP said equipment near Waterloo Road failed at 11.18pm on Wednesday, cutting supply to about 1,000 customers; full restoration came after a second morning interruption.

zh.headline: 何文田旺角停電後復電 中電指今早一度再受影響
zh.dek: 中電表示周三晚上11時18分窩打老道附近設備故障，約1,000名客戶受影響；清晨復電後今早臨時供電不穩，約650戶一度再停電。

en.headline: Hong Kong women reach Asian Games squash final
en.dek: Ho Tze-lok won the decider against India as the team advanced 2-1 in Nagoya, while sailors added silver and bronze in the 49er class on day 12.

zh.headline: 亞運女子壁球隊晉級決賽
zh.dek: 何子樂擊敗印度對手鎖定2比1勝局，港隊周五爭金；帆船49人級同日添一銀一銅。

en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail booked out on National Day
en.dek: AFCD Director Leung Kin-ming inspected the High Island booking scheme as the 2,000 daily cap filled for 1 and 2 October; the nearby Pak Lap Tsui section needs no reservation.

zh.headline: 國慶破邊洲段預約額滿 漁護署長到場視察
zh.dek: 黃金周試行預約制，10月1及2日全日2,000個名額已滿；未預約者可改走免預約的標尖角段。

en.headline: Yellow work heat warning issued on National Day
en.dek: The Labour Department put the yellow Heat Stress at Work Warning in force at 11.30am as the Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning up and temperatures reached about 35 degrees.

zh.headline: 國慶黃色工作暑熱警告生效
zh.dek: 勞工處今日上午11時30分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，天文台酷熱天氣警告持續，部分地區中午氣溫約35度。

en.headline: Retailers see Golden Week lift, groups warn gains may be modest
en.dek: Some shops forecast double-digit growth as 1.29 million mainland visitors are expected, but an economist said receipts may not rise in line with arrivals.

zh.headline: 黃金周有商戶料銷售雙位數增長 團體提醒升幅或有限
zh.dek: 官方估計十一黃金周約129萬內地旅客來港，有商戶看好銷售，但經濟學家指零售額升幅未必與人流同步。

en.headline: WestK Picnic Fest runs through the National Day holiday at Art Park
en.dek: The harbourfront lawn programme continues today with a shorter market and workshops, and picnic-kit rental from late morning.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節國慶假期續辦 藝術公園海濱東草坪
zh.dek: 西九文化區在藝術公園海濱東草坪辦野餐節，今日市集和工作坊時間較短，野餐用品上午已可租借。

en.headline: Lee ties National Day speech to Hong Kong's first five-year plan
en.dek: At the Convention Centre reception, the Chief Executive called the plan a roadmap under one country, two systems, while astronaut Lai Ka-ying sent a video greeting from Tiangong.

zh.headline: 國慶酒會李家超談首份五年規劃 黎家盈太空送祝辭
zh.dek: 特首在會展國慶酒會稱，五年規劃是在一國兩制下的策略路線圖；神舟二十三號載荷專家黎家盈亦從天宮錄影致賀。

en.headline: Sha Tin public stands free for National Day racing
en.dek: The Jockey Club opens Sha Tin at 11am, with the first race at 1pm and a Grade Three National Day Cup over 1,000 metres; Happy Valley public stands are also free for people aged 18 or above.

zh.headline: 國慶賽馬日沙田公眾席免費開放
zh.dek: 馬會今日在沙田舉行國慶賽馬日，上午11時開放，首場下午1時開跑，焦點為總獎金420萬元的三級賽國慶盈；年滿18歲人士可免費進入沙田及跑馬地公眾席。

en.headline: Officials expect 1.29 million Golden Week visitors
en.dek: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said mainland arrivals over the National Day holiday are forecast to rise 5 per cent, after Mid-Autumn visitor numbers increased by more than 20 per cent.

zh.headline: 文體旅局料黃金周內地客129萬人次
zh.dek: 局長羅淑佩表示，國慶黃金周訪港內地旅客預計達129萬人次，按年升約5%；中秋訪港人次已升兩成或以上，酒店入住率料達九成或以上。

en.headline: PolyU programme to train 17,000 seniors on safer falls
en.dek: A 45-month Jockey Club-funded project launched on Wednesday will combine bone-density checks, an AI risk score and judo-based landing drills for people aged 60 or above.

zh.headline: 理大推防跌計劃 料惠及1.7萬名長者
zh.dek: 賽馬會資助的45個月計劃周三啟動，結合骨質密度檢測、人工智能跌倒評估及柔道安全着地訓練，對象為60歲或以上社區長者。

en.headline: St Joseph's Primary rebuild clears internal government checks
en.dek: Principal Lam Mei-kei told parents the Wan Chai school's long-planned in-situ project has passed internal approval and can now move toward detailed design, tendering and a funding bid to the Legislative Council.

zh.headline: 聖若瑟小學原址重建通過內部審批
zh.dek: 校長林美琪向家長發信，指灣仔活道校舍重建已獲政府內部審批，下一步將定稿設計、招標及向立法會申請撥款，若順利可望明年底動工。

en.headline: Fourth rat hepatitis E case linked to Kowloon City home
en.dek: An 80-year-old woman living in the same Kowloon City care home as a 91-year-old man confirmed last week tested positive and remains without symptoms, the Centre for Health Protection said.

zh.headline: 大鼠戊肝再多一宗 與九龍城院舍個案有關連
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，與上周確診的91歲男子同住九龍城安老院的80歲女家屬驗出大鼠戊型肝炎，沒有病徵，情況穩定，屬今年第四宗。

en.headline: LCSD venues free and cinema tickets half-price on National Day
en.dek: Residents can book selected Leisure and Cultural Services Department sports facilities at no charge today, while 52 commercial cinemas sell half-price tickets and trams run free.

zh.headline: 國慶康文署設施免費 戲票半價電車免車費
zh.dek: 今日以個人身分可免費預訂康文署部分收費康樂設施，全港52間商業戲院半價，電車全線免車費，濕地公園亦免費開放。

en.headline: Very hot weather and yellow fire danger warnings in force
en.dek: The Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning up for National Day and issued a yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am, forecasting 34 degrees in urban areas.

zh.headline: 國慶酷熱及黃色火災危險警告生效
zh.dek: 天文台酷熱天氣警告自九月二十八日上午十一時十五分生效，今早六時再發黃色火災危險警告，市區最高氣溫約34度。

en.headline: Hong Kong beat Brunei 2-0 to reach ASEAN Cup final
en.dek: Chan Siu-kwan and Matt Orr scored at Kai Tak Sports Park as the team finished Group A with two wins and will face Cambodia on Saturday.

zh.headline: 港隊2比0勝汶萊 東盟盃決賽鬥柬埔寨
zh.dek: 陳肇鈞下半場頭槌破網，安永佳補時鎖定勝局，港隊兩戰全勝以A組首名晉級，周六再戰啟德對柬埔寨。

en.headline: Australian man arrested over imitation pistol in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police seized a suspected replica Mauser pistol after a report near a Temple Street bar on Wednesday night and held a 46-year-old man for possessing an imitation firearm.

zh.headline: 油麻地檢獲仿製曲尺手槍 拘捕澳洲籍男子
zh.dek: 周三晚約十時廟街酒吧一帶有人報稱懷疑有人藏有手槍物體，警方檢獲仿製曲尺手槍，以涉嫌管有仿製槍械拘捕46歲澳洲籍男子。

en.headline: Twelve cars punctured by nails on Tsing Yi North Coastal Road
en.dek: Police collected 16 nails after drivers heading towards Lantau reported blowouts near an Environmental Protection Department emissions site on Wednesday evening.

zh.headline: 青衣北岸公路16枚鐵釘 12車爆胎
zh.dek: 周三晚往大嶼山方向近環保署廢氣實測室對開，警方檢獲16枚鐵釘，列刑事毀壞，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: CLP fault cuts power to about 1,000 Ho Man Tin customers
en.dek: Equipment near Waterloo Road failed at about 11.18pm; an elderly man on an oxygen machine was taken to hospital and firefighters freed two lifts.

zh.headline: 窩打老道中電設備故障 約千戶停電
zh.dek: 昨晚約十一時十八分九龍城窩打老道附近設備故障，何文田及附近約一千客戶受影響，氧氣機停頓老翁送院，消防接至少兩宗升降機困人。

en.headline: Visitor spends HK$10,000 McDonald's prize treating strangers
en.dek: A mainland tourist who won an Alipay voucher valid only in Hong Kong spent about a day buying meals for passers-by, cleaners and older diners before leaving the city.

zh.headline: 內地旅客抽中萬元麥當勞券請途人吃飯
zh.dek: 遊客透過支付寶抽中只限香港分店使用的一萬元優惠，離港前約24小時走訪灣仔及尖沙咀分店請客。

en.headline: Flag-raising at 8am, harbour fireworks at 8pm for National Day
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee leads the Golden Bauhinia Square ceremony this morning; police expect about 260,000 people along Victoria Harbour tonight and will close roads in phases from 4pm.

zh.headline: 國慶今早金紫荊升旗 晚上八時維港放煙花
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超出席上午八時升旗及會展酒會；警方料約26萬人沿維港觀賞晚上匯演，下午四時起分階段封路。

en.headline: Passengers steer taxi after driver faints on Ching Cheung Road
en.dek: Four passengers were unhurt after a 66-year-old taxi driver lost consciousness near noon on Monday; local reports said he remained in a critical condition.

zh.headline: 呈祥道的士司機昏迷 乘客協助停車無人受傷
zh.dek: 周一中午66歲司機在長沙灣呈祥道近樂軒臺一帶突然失去知覺，四名乘客無羔；報道指司機其後情況危殆。

en.headline: Hot National Day, then showers over the long weekend
en.dek: The Observatory expects Thursday to stay very hot before cloud and rain become more likely from Friday through Sunday.

zh.headline: 國慶酷熱其後有驟雨 長假期天氣展望
zh.dek: 天文台預計星期四仍然酷熱，周五至周日轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區或有雷暴。

en.headline: Salmonella found in Wan Chai Hainan chicken rice sample
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said a ready-to-eat sample from a restaurant in Tin Lok Lane failed microbiological guidelines and the dish was taken off sale.

zh.headline: 灣仔海南雞飯樣本驗出沙門氏菌
zh.dek: 食安中心指天樂里食肆即食樣本不符合微生物指引，食肆已按指示停售及棄置相關食品。

en.headline: New World books heavy loss after handing back 11 Skies
en.dek: The developer reported a full-year loss after impairments and an early-termination fee tied to returning the airport mall project to the Airport Authority.

zh.headline: 新世界交還11 SKIES後全年大蝕
zh.dek: 發展商公布截至6月底全年虧損約268億元，主因提早終止機場商場項目並計提減值及終止費用。

en.headline: High Court grants Pansy Ho permanent harassment injunction
en.dek: A deputy judge found repeated approaches and false allegations since March 2025 justified a lasting order keeping the defendant away from Ho and her offices.

zh.headline: 高院向何超瓊頒永久禁制令禁騷擾
zh.dek: 暫委法官裁定被告自2025年3月起重複接觸及作出失實指控，禁制對方聯絡何超瓊或靠近其公司辦事處。

en.headline: Government books HK$19 billion deficit after five months
en.dek: Spending outpaced receipts to end-August as salaries and profits tax have yet to come in; fiscal reserves stood at HK$646.5 billion.

zh.headline: 政府首五個月錄約190億元赤字
zh.dek: 截至8月底開支3,110億、收入2,492億，計入發債及還債後赤字約190億；財政儲備6466億。

en.headline: DFI to take over Asia Starbucks as Maxim's buys back stake
en.dek: The Wellcome and Mannings parent will receive more than 1,100 licensed coffeehouses plus about US$340 million in cash, with completion targeted by early 2027.

zh.headline: DFI讓出美心股權換星巴克亞洲業務及3.4億美元
zh.dek: 惠康及萬寧母企將承接七個市場逾1,100間特許星巴克，並收取約3.4億美元現金，料2027年首季完成。

en.headline: New mortgage approvals fall 28 percent in August
en.dek: The Monetary Authority said banks approved HK$32.2 billion of home loans last month, while drawdowns rose and arrears stayed low.

zh.headline: 八月新批住宅按揭買款按月跌28%
zh.dek: 金管局公布新批額減至322億元，新取用反升至328億，拖欠比率仍低於0.11%。

en.headline: KMB and LWB add Golden Week trips and half-price visitor pass
en.dek: Children ride free on National Day across more than 480 routes, while extra buses are planned for borders, the airport and countryside links.

zh.headline: 九巴龍運黃金周加開班次 旅客日票半價
zh.dek: 國慶日兒童可免費乘搭超過480條路線；口岸、高鐵站及郊遊路線將加開，皇崗口岸亦擁新線。

en.headline: ICAC charges former crypto shop staff over diverted USDT trades
en.dek: A former Sheung Shui shop assistant is accused of taking bribes to shift customer Tether deals into other wallets, totalling nearly HK$9 million.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴加密幣找換店前職員涉收賄轉移交易
zh.dek: 指上水分店前職員暗中將客戶泰達幣買賣轉至他人錢包，三個月交易額近九百萬元，周五粉嶺裁判法院答辯。

en.headline: Palace Museum opens Qing imperial workshops exhibition
en.dek: Design for the Forbidden City, a joint show with the Palace Museum in Beijing, puts 157 objects on view from Wednesday, including 14 Grade-One relics.

zh.headline: 香港故宮開展「清宮製造與當代設計」
zh.dek: 與北京故宮博物院合辦的專題展星期三起開放，展出157件文物，包括14件國家一級文物。

en.headline: Exchange Fund assets fall to HK$4.34 trillion at end-August
en.dek: The Monetary Authority said the drop of HK$68.3 billion from July was mainly due to withdrawals of Fiscal Reserves placements.

zh.headline: 外匯基金8月底總資產降至4.34萬億
zh.dek: 金管局公布較7月底減少683億元，主因提取財政儲備存款；支持比率升至112%。

en.headline: Central Kowloon Route Kowloon Bay section to open 6 December
en.dek: Transport chief Mable Chan told LegCo the last stretch of Route 6 will cut peak Tseung Kwan O to Yau Ma Tei trips to about 12 minutes.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道九龍灣段12月6日通車
zh.dek: 陳美寶向立法會表示，六號幹線全面啟用後，繁忙時間將軍澳往油麻地車程料由約65分鐘減至約12分鐘。

en.headline: Family of four hospitalised after Sha Tin estate fire
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze at Yan Chuen House, Shui Chuen O Estate, around 7.10am; about 140 to 200 residents were evacuated.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邨欣泉樓火警 一家四口送院
zh.dek: 消防早上約7時10分救熄15樓單位火警，約140至200名居民疏散，四人懷疑吸入濃煙送院。

en.headline: Victoria Park lantern displays extended to 7 October
en.dek: The Tourism Board and Leisure and Cultural Services Department said about 580,000 visits were recorded in 13 days, with one day topping 200,000.

zh.headline: 維園中秋絳燈展延至10月7日
zh.dek: 旅發局及康文署表示，9月17日至29日約58萬人次到訪，單日高峰超過20萬，展期覆蓋國慶黃金周。

en.headline: Health authorities confirm imported mpox case
en.dek: A 40-year-old man is in stable condition at Princess Margaret Hospital after high-risk contact while outside Hong Kong, the Centre for Health Protection said.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心公布一宗輸入猴痘個案
zh.dek: 一名40歲男子潛伏期在外地有高風險性接觸，現於瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，情況穩定。

en.headline: Hong Kong studying more no-booking days for northbound cars
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the city is talking with Guangdong about extending the Tuesday-Wednesday waiver to other quieter weekdays.

zh.headline: 港粵研究更多工作日港車北上免預約
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶向立法會表示，正與廣東商討把週二、三免預約安排擴至其他非繁忙工作天。

en.headline: Seven firms win IP-backed loans in first sandbox batch
en.dek: Banks completed credit approval on seven pilot cases worth HK$1 million to HK$39 million, the Monetary Authority and government said.

zh.headline: 知識產權融資沙盒首批七宗個案獲批
zh.dek: 金管局公布參與銀行完成七宗試點審批，貸款由100萬至3,900萬元，涵蓋電子、建築、玩具及醫療器材。

en.headline: Tourism Board stages first Hong Kong Halloween Month
en.dek: Street parties are planned on three Saturdays from 17 October in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦香港萬聖月 三個周六街頭派對
zh.dek: 十月十七日起一連三個星期六，中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖東將舉辦萬聖節街頭活動，萬聖夜作結。

en.headline: Commodities working group holds first meeting
en.dek: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui chaired the panel created in this year's Policy Address, with gold as the first focus.

zh.headline: 大宗商品交易聯合工作組召開首次會議
zh.dek: 財庫局局長許正宇主持施政報告提出的工作組首次會議，表明以黃金為切入點推進交易生態圈。

en.headline: HZMB fresh food imports go 24 hours from Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety said vehicles carrying designated fresh produce via the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge may enter at any hour from midnight.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋鮮活食品周四起全日通關
zh.dek: 食安中心表示，十月一日零時起經港珠澳大橋進口指定鮮活食品可全日24小時入境，文錦渡維持朝七晚十。

en.headline: Yellow work heat stress warning issued as heat persists
en.dek: The Labour Department raised the yellow warning at 10.10am, while the Observatory’s Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告生效 酷熱天氣警告持續
zh.dek: 勞工處星期三上午10時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告；天文台酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。

en.headline: National security police arrest two over alleged incitement
en.dek: The National Security Department detained two people on Wednesday, including the founder of online outlet Boom News, over events outside Prince Edward station on 31 August.

zh.headline: 國安處拘兩人涉發布假消息煽動 包括網媒創辦人
zh.dek: 警方國家安全處星期三早上拘捕兩人，包括網媒「爆炸頭」創辦人，指與8月31日太子站外事件有關。

en.headline: Man found dead in Shing Mun River near Fo Tan
en.dek: A passer-by spotted a person in the water near Tsui Yung Bridge on Wednesday morning; rescuers recovered a man who was certified dead.

zh.headline: 沙田城門河發現男浮屍 身份待查
zh.dek: 星期三早上有途人在沙田翠榕橋附近發現河中有人，救援人員救起一名男子後當場證實死亡。

en.headline: HSBC names Hong Kong stablecoin RedCoin for PayMe users
en.dek: The bank said HSBC RedCoin would be offered through PayMe and its Hong Kong mobile app before the end of the year.

zh.headline: 滙豐將港元穩定幣定名RedCoin 擬經PayMe推出
zh.dek: 滙豐表示，HSBC RedCoin將於今年年底前經PayMe及香港流動理財應用程式提供予用戶。

en.headline: Retired woman loses HK$2.9 million in romance scam
en.dek: Police said at least 18 online romance frauds were reported in a week, with combined losses near HK$7.8 million, after a 71-year-old was lured into a fake investment.

zh.headline: 七旬婦墮網上情緣騙局失近290萬
zh.dek: 警方公布過去一周至少18宗網上情緣騙案、合共接近780萬元，其中一名71歲退休女子被誘投資後轉賬17次。

en.headline: Cheuk says birth package may have slowed a steeper fall
en.dek: The deputy chief secretary told LegCo the government's medium-term aim is to stop a cliff-edge drop in births, and he reserved judgment on restoring a universal student grant.

zh.headline: 卓永興：無組合拳生育率跌幅或更嚴重
zh.dek: 政務司副司長在立法會表示，中期目標是避免出生率斷崖式下跌，並對重推二千五百元學生津貼有保留。

en.headline: About 20 evacuated after Mong Kok guesthouse fire
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze on the second floor of a Bute Street building shortly after 2am; one staff member was lightly hurt and refused hospital treatment.

zh.headline: 旺角弼街賓館凌晨起火 約20人疏散一人輕傷
zh.dek: 消防凌晨兩時許救熄旺角利發大樓二樓賓館火警，一名男職員自行撲火時輕傷拒送院，暫無可疑。

en.headline: Palace Museum opens Qing imperial workshop exhibition
en.dek: Design for the Forbidden City, jointly organised with Beijing's Palace Museum, puts more than 150 workshop objects on view in Gallery 5 from Wednesday.

zh.headline: 香港故宮開展清宮製造與當代設計
zh.dek: 與北京故宮博物院合辦的專題展周三起在西九展廳五對外開放，展出造辦處文物一百五十多件。

en.headline: Consultants and contractors may join building repair lists from today
en.dek: The Development Bureau opened a four-week application window for three pre-qualification lists that will govern future large-scale maintenance tenders.

zh.headline: 樓宇維修三張預審名單今起接受申請
zh.dek: 發展局星期三起就驗樓顧問、監督顧問及承建商三張預審名單接受申請，為期四星期至十月二十七日。

en.headline: Four hurt in early morning fire at Shui Chuen O Estate
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a Yan Chuen House flat in Sha Tin shortly after 7am; a family of four was injured and about 140 residents left the block.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邸欣泉樓火警 一家四口受傷
zh.dek: 周三早上六時許沙田水泉澳邸欣泉樓單位起火，消防七時十分救熄，一家四口受傷，約140名住客落樓暫避。

en.headline: Five Hong Kong universities remain in THE world top 100
en.dek: Times Higher Education's 2027 ranking keeps HKU at 33rd, with CityU rising three places to a record 70th and all eight UGC-funded universities inside the top 300.

zh.headline: THE世界大學排名港五校續入百強 城大升至70創高
zh.dek: 2027年泰普仕高等教育排名公布，港大維持全球第33、全港第一，城大升33位至第70創新高，八大全部打入全球首300。

en.headline: Heritage Discovery Centre stages National Day family fun day
en.dek: The Antiquities and Monuments Office will fill Kowloon Park's heritage centre on Thursday with free workshops, concerts and games from 10am to 7pm.

zh.headline: 古跡辦國慶文物同樂日 九龍公園免費開放
zh.dek: 發展局古物古跡辦事處星期四上午十時至晚上七時，在尖沙咀香港文物探知館舉辦工作坊、音樂會及遊戲，入場免費。

en.headline: Kwai Chung community living room opens as city's 17th
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said the 2,300-square-foot centre is expected to serve about 250 subdivided-flat households and 40,000 visits a year.

zh.headline: 葵涌社區客廳開幕 全港增至十七間
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基主持開幕，指二千三百平方呎客廳預計每年服務二百五十個劍房戶、約四萬人次。

en.headline: Public secondary schools lose four S1 classes after headcount
en.dek: The Education Bureau said no public secondary school fell below two classes in Secondary One, Two or Four, so none must apply for a development plan this year.

zh.headline: 點人頭後公營中學減四班中一 沒有學校陷殺校程序
zh.dek: 教育局公布本學年公營中學經九月點算後共減四班中一，小學小一班數不變，亦沒有中學因不足兩班而須申請發展方案。

en.headline: Two men charged over alleged HK$9 million procurement fraud
en.dek: A former systems engineer at Pacific Textiles and a relative appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today after the ICAC charged them with fraud over IT purchases.

zh.headline: 互太前工程師涉隱瞞利益採購九百萬 廉署起訴兩人
zh.dek: 廉署起訴互太紡織前系統工程師及其親戚各欺詐罪，指他們在約九百萬元資訊科技採購中隱瞞利益衝突，兩人今於西九龍裁判法院應訊。

en.headline: Hospital Authority deploys AI and robots at Tung Chung support centre
en.dek: The central laundry and meal production facility uses robotic arms, X-ray sorting and cook-chill technology to serve about half of public hospitals' demand while improving worker safety.

zh.headline: 醫管局東涌支援服務中心引入AI及機械臂處理洗衣膳食
zh.dek: 中央洗衣及煮餐設施採用機械臂、X光分揀及速涼技術，約滿足公立醫院一半需求，同時提升員工職業安全。

en.headline: Police smash Kwun Tong phone fraud centre, arrest 20
en.dek: Officers raided an industrial unit used as a call centre by a local syndicate that posed as debt collectors, linking the group to at least 16 cases and more than HK$1.3 million in losses.

zh.headline: 警搗觀塘電話騙案中心拘20人 涉至少16宗共130萬元
zh.dek: 東九龍總區突擊搜查觀塘工廈單位，搗破假扮收數公司的本地詐騙集團，拘捕包括主腦在內20人，涉串謀行騙及洗黑錢。

en.headline: Hong Kong rises to 14th in Global Innovation Index 2026
en.dek: The city advanced one place among 139 economies and stayed fifth in Asia, with strong marks for credit, tertiary education and market sophistication, the World Intellectual Property Organization said.

zh.headline: 全球創新指數香港升至第14位 亞洲保持第五
zh.dek: 世界知識產權組織公布2026年《全球創新指數》，香港在139個經濟體中再升一位至第14，亞洲維持第五，信貸繼續全球第一。

en.headline: Government prices record HK$20 billion digital green bonds
en.dek: The fourth multi-currency digital green bond issuance under the Sustainable Bond Programme was oversubscribed and set a new global record for the largest digital bond offering of its kind.

zh.headline: 政府成功定價約200億元等值數碼綠色債券 刷新全球紀錄
zh.dek: 特區政府在可持續債券計劃下第四次發行數碼綠色債券，涵蓋港元、人民幣、美元及歐元，規模為全球同類最大，並獲超額認購。

en.headline: Police log 1,503 suspicious iPhone charges worth over HK$30 million
en.dek: All unauthorised transactions linked to Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders have been cancelled, with no losses to cardholders, banks or the company, the police commissioner said.

zh.headline: 警接1503宗可疑iPhone交易涉逾3000萬 所有交易已取消
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，涉及蘋果iPhone 18 Pro預購的可疑信用卡交易增至1503宗，涉款逾3000萬元，全部交易已取消，卡主、銀行及公司均無損失。

en.headline: Hong Kong man returns home after 26 years in Philippine prison
en.dek: Tang Lung-wai, 55, arrived at Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday evening accompanied by Immigration Department officers after completing his sentence for a drug conviction he has long disputed.

zh.headline: 港人鄧龍威菲律賓服刑26年後返港 入境處人員陪同
zh.dek: 55歲鄧龍威周二晚在入境處人員陪同下由馬尼拉返抵香港國際機場，結束因藏毒案在菲國渡過的26年鐵窗生涯，他一直堅稱無罪。

en.headline: Hoi Fan Road Park in Yau Tsim Mong opens to the public on Wednesday
en.dek: The new 16,000-square-metre park offers a seven-a-side artificial turf pitch, basketball and volleyball courts, fitness facilities, a community garden and an inclusive children’s playground, and is pet-friendly.

zh.headline: 油尖旺海帆道公園明日起開放 設七人足球場及共融遊樂場
zh.dek: 新落成公園佔地約1.6萬平方米，提供人造草足球場、籃球排球場、健體設施、社區園圃及共融兒童遊樂場，並開放予寵物進入。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court residents begin selecting replacement subsidised flats
en.dek: The first 35 households that accepted buy-back offers by the June deadline started choosing from about 4,400 units across 10 estates under the special sales arrangement on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 宏福苑特設銷售計劃今起揀樓 首批約35戶優先選購
zh.dek: 首批於6月30日前簽署接納書的約35戶業主，周二起於觀塘綠置居銷售小組辦事處開始揀選約4400個資助房屋單位。

en.headline: Tourism Board launches Hong Kong Halloween Month with street parties
en.dek: Street celebrations will run across five neighbourhoods on three consecutive Saturdays from 17 October, with free rides on decorated buses and trams for costumed visitors.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦香港萬聖月 三個周六街頭派對免費乘車
zh.dek: 10月17日起一連三個周六於中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖沙咀東舉行街頭派對，穿萬聖節裝扮可免費乘開篷巴士及派對電車。
